description: T-2848: when delete_row deletes sheet row 4, the only data row of Sales on S!B3:C4 (header B3:C3 Region/Qty, data row 4), what happens to the cells of that sheet row outside the table? S!E4 5 sits beside the table, S!E5 9 below E4, S!B5 'below' and S!C5 7 below the table. Sheet F holds A1 =S!E4, A3 =S!E5, A5 =S!C5, A7 =SUM(S!C4:C5), A9 =ROWS(Sales), A10 =ROWS(Sales[#All]), A11 =SUM(Sales[Qty]), each value followed by its FORMULATEXT where listed (A2, A4, A6, A8).
